description: Trigger a Stitch (Talend/Qlik) replication job via the Stitch Connect API — fire-and-forget or wait for completion.

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.description: Stitch client ID (stitch_client_id), used to list extraction history for polling

api_token_env.label: API Token Env Var
api_token_env.description: Env var holding the Stitch Connect API access token (Bearer; generated in Stitch account settings, does not expire)

wait_for_completion.label: Wait For Completion
wait_for_completion.description: Poll Stitch's extraction history until this source's sync finishes. Best-effort (see README) — Stitch's API gives no single run-id to poll directly.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between polls. Stitch rate-limits extraction endpoints to 30 requests/10 minutes — keep this >= 20

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait before giving up
